defs.def: a piece of furniture for sleeping on 床

ex.s: I would feel completely at ease doing my homework in bed, with light music on.
ex.t: 我喜欢躺在床上做作业，放着轻音乐，感觉无比自在。

ex.s: I found comfort in keeping myself awake when everyone else had gone to bed, and I loved the silence of the night.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的“安静”标志到处都是。如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: My roommates would tell me to go to bed and get up early the following morning to do it instead.
ex.t: 室友们会劝我去睡觉，第二天早上早点起来再做。

ex.s: I woke up most mornings with a dull, grey feeling as I forced myself out of bed to start the day.
ex.t: 大多数早晨我醒来时都带着一种沉闷、灰暗的感觉，强迫自己起床开始新的一天。

ex.s: I am down there in my wheelchair in the morning letting the hens out and down there again at night to see they’ve gone to bed.”
ex.t: 我早上坐着轮椅下去放母鸡，晚上又下去看它们睡觉。"

ex.s: It offers beautiful furnishings and beds.
ex.t: 它提供精美的家具和床铺。

ex.s: There was a nice kitchen and a comfortable bed.
ex.t: 有一个不错的厨房和一张舒适的床。

ex.s: How pleased and proud Mother would be when they brought her breakfast in bed.
ex.t: 当他们把早餐送到床上时，妈妈会多么高兴和自豪。

ex.s: How pleased and proud Mother would be when they brought her breakfast in bed.

ex.s: There was a man sick in bed, his wife, who took care of him and could not go out to work, and their little boy.
ex.t: 有一位生病卧床的男人，他的妻子照顾他、无法外出工作，还有他们的小男孩。

ex.s: There was a man sick in bed, his wife, who took care of him and could not go out to work, and their little boy.

ex.s: The bed is too soft.
ex.t: 他可能会换衬衫因为它太小了。

ex.s: The bed is too hard.
ex.t: 床太硬了。

ex.s: 38    Instead, we had a pop-up camper with comfortable beds and an air conditioner.
ex.t: 38    相反，我们有了一辆带有舒适床铺和空调的折叠式房车。

ex.s: 32  his own ill health, he continued to coach me from his hospital bed in the days that followed.
ex.t: 32 尽管他自己身体不好，在接下来的日子里他继续在医院床上指导我。

ex.s: In this part adapted from a chapter of the book, Aronnax describes the experience of walking on the sea bed… 1 And now, how can I look back upon the impression left upon me by that walk under the waters?
ex.t: 在本部分改编自本书的一章，阿龙纳斯描述了在海床上行走的经历…… 1现在，我如何回顾在水下行走给我留下的印象？

ex.s: Long curtains had been pulled around my bed,  16  me from the other patients.
ex.t: 长窗帘已经被拉到我的床边，16 把我和其他病人隔开。

ex.s: On the other side of my bed curtain, I heard a patient cheerfully  18  every nurse as they entered the room, as if welcoming each into his home.
ex.t: 在我的床帘另一边，我听到一位病人愉快地18 每一位进来的护士，仿佛欢迎她们来到他的家中。

ex.s: Bent over my laptop while sitting on the bed in the corner of my room, I suddenly felt a pounding headache, and had to lie down.
ex.t: 我弓着背坐在房间角落的床上盯着笔记本电脑，突然感到一阵剧烈的头痛，不得不躺下。

ex.s: On the fourth day, I was so tired that I even didn't want to get out of bed.
ex.t: 第四天，我太累了，甚至不想起床。

ex.s: I go to bed at ten o'clock.
ex.t: 我十点钟上床睡觉。

ex.s: An hour’s sport each day left me tired out and wanting to go to bed early.
ex.t: 每天一小时的运动让我筋疲力尽，想早点上床睡觉。

ex.s: You have a job, earned your degree, and you got out of bed today.
ex.t: 你有工作，拿到了学位，而且今天你起了床。

defs.def: the bottom of a river, the sea, etc. （河）床；（海等的）底

ex.s: The ship rests upright on the sea bed, about 30 metres below the waves.
ex.t: 这艘船直立地静卧在海床上，大约在海浪下30米处。

defs.def: an area of ground in a garden/yard or park for growing flowers, vegetables, etc. 花坛；苗圃；菜园
a layer of sth that other things lie or rest on 底层；基；基座
a layer of clay, rock, etc. in the ground （地下由黏土、岩石等构成的）地层
to fix sth firmly in sth 把 … 固定在
to have sex with sb 与（某人）发生性关系
